stateController.notes: HostCreateOrganizerScreen is the route-facing wrapper for the create-only CreateOrganizerScreen. CreateOrganizerScreen owns PageController step state, form controllers, draft restoration/saving, cover/profile photo picking, host defaults, Event Success defaults, submit mutation execution, and the actual Navigator pop side effect.
